title: TheCalcMod
description: A mod adding the Calc item to Minecraft
body:
# Calc
This is a very small yet a **very important mod**. It adds custom technological progression with **5** brand new items:
1. Transistor
2. Motherboard
3. Screen
4. Solar Panel
5. **The Calc**, the main item of the mod, the goal of it.
 An item with an _ability so strong_ I won't mention it here and it is up to you to find it out. (To use it just right-click).

If you want a very easy technological challenge with a small reward at the end, this mod is perfect for you


Thanks a lot to MCreator for their easy to use app.
